builds.name: Reference: Critical duel
builds.goal: Reference for Yone: establish a repeatable reference
builds.hypothesis: A melee attack skirmisher who builds a knock-up through Q, takes temporary spirit-form trades and returns after amplifying his attack and ability damage. Record Q knockup readiness and E spirit damage replay. Do not apply replay twice or treat E as a free permanent position; attack-speed/Q limits still matter. Crit attacks and a conditional shield test repeated duel windows.
builds.summary: Crit attacks and a conditional shield test repeated duel windows.
testPlan: Kit question for Yone: Record Q knockup readiness and E spirit damage replay. Do not apply replay twice or treat E as a free permanent position; attack-speed/Q limits still matter.

Start with the early core (Kraken, then Navori if attack-driven recycling works) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Use this as the control for the other three routes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Resource: Flow. Do not treat mana regeneration as Flow recovery; Nimbus replaces Manaflow when that Sorcery row is used.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: Crit attacks and a conditional shield test repeated duel windows. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern.

Q evidence: Thrusts forward, damaging all enemies in a line.

On hit, grants a stack of Gathering Storm for a few seconds. At 2 stacks, Mortal Steel dashes Yone forward with a gust of wind knocking enemies Airborne. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.

Higher dummy damage is offset by fewer landed actions, deaths before the useful window, or worse ally utility.
tradeoffs: A Lifeline slot excludes Sterak/Maw; melee access or ranged spacing must be earned.

Infinity Edge, Immortal Shieldbow, Lord Dominik's Regards are later or conditional slots; do not postpone necessary protection for a six-item ceiling.

kitEvidence.formula:
Yone thrusts forward, dealing [25 / 50 / 75 / 100 / 125 + (1.1) × AD] physical damage.

On hit, grants a stack for [6] seconds. At 2 stacks, this ability causes Yone to dash forward with a wave of wind that Knocks Up for [0.75] seconds and deals [25 / 50 / 75 / 100 / 125 + (1.1) × AD] physical damage.

Yone strikes all enemies along a path for [(200 / 400 / 600 + (0.8) × AD[statFormula=2]) × (0.5)] physical damage and [(200 / 400 / 600 + (0.8) × AD[statFormula=2]) × (0.5)] magic damage, teleporting behind the last champion hit and Knocking Up victims towards Yone.

Yone enters a spirit form for [5] seconds, leaving his body behind for the duration and gaining [10]% to [30]% ramping Move Speed. 

When the spirit form ends, Yone snaps back to his body and repeats [(0.25 / 0.275 / 0.3 / 0.325 / 0.35) × 100]% of all Attack and Ability damage he dealt to champions during this time. You may Recast this ability during spirit form.

Recast: End spirit form early.

Yone cleaves forward, dealing [(10 / 20 / 30 / 40 / 50) × 0.5] + [(0.08 / 0.09 / 0.1 / 0.11 / 0.12) × 50]% max Health physical damage and [(10 / 20 / 30 / 40 / 50) × 0.5] + [(0.08 / 0.09 / 0.1 / 0.11 / 0.12) × 50]% max Health magic damage.

If Yone hits, he gains [characterLevelInterpolation(40 → 90; raw flags preserved) + (0.65) × AD[statFormula=2]] Shield for [1.5] seconds. The amount of Shield increases for each champion struck.

Steel and Spirit: Yone uses two blades, causing every second Attack to deal [50]% magic damage.

Intent: Yone's Critical Strike Chance is increased by [100]% but his Critical Strike Damage is reduced to [(1) × Stat(9)]. Gain @YoneCritToAD*.01@ Bonus AD for every 1% Critical Strike Chance above 100%.

builds.name: Mixed-blade penetration ramp
builds.summary: Test whether finite mixed penetration repays reduced crit investment during an E window.
builds.goal: Test whether finite mixed penetration repays reduced crit investment during an E window.
builds.hypothesis: Passive every second attack deals half magic damage; W and R split physical/magic damage. Terminus provides finite armor/MR penetration and defensive stacks through champion attacks, while Rageblade/BotRK support attack packets. E lasts five seconds and repeats a share of documented attack/ability damage, so proc inclusion remains a separate question.
testPlan: Required state: Fix crit cap, initial Terminus/Rageblade stacks and complete attacks inside one E duration.
Separate physical/magic packets and E repeat with zero versus recorded pre-stacks.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Ramp occurs after the target disengages or the return body is threatened.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Item on-hit damage is not automatically included in E repeat merely because it accompanied an attack.
Confidence: speculative. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Blade of The Ruined King, Guinsoo's Rageblade, Terminus, Immortal Shieldbow, Infinity Edge, Berserker's Greaves. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

builds.name: Cleave shield duel
builds.summary: Use a health/AD route to protect repeated W hits during a bounded spirit trade.
builds.goal: Use a health/AD route to protect repeated W hits during a bounded spirit trade.
builds.hypothesis: W hits grant an AD[statFormula=2] shield increased per champion struck; Visage enhances self shields. Bloodmail gives bounded health-to-AD and missing-health AD, supporting that shield if its retained flag is confirmed. Trinity supplies an actual attack Spellblade and Sundered Sky tests first-attack healing while Q/R provide access.
testPlan: Required state: Observed AD/health fixed, W hits one versus two champions and E return body stays safe.
Log W shield per victim, damage and health retained over a five-second E exchange.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Reduced crit damage/attack speed may lose the trade despite larger shields.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: W shield target count does not make all W damage or health scalings multiply freely.
Confidence: speculative. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
